architectureDecisions.evidence: Search Console 2026-05-18..2026-08-18: 12 impressions in three months at average position 45.7, on four queries only — «интернет маркетинг ташкент» 33.25, «маркетинг под ключ» 22.0, «digital marketing ташкент» 64.5 and «услуги интернет маркетинг узбукистан» 82.0. The internal graph gives it 19 inbound links, the second-highest of any commercial page, which makes it the worst link-to-return ratio in the marketing cluster. Google Ads data for location 2860 pulled 2026-08-22 explains why: «интернет маркетинг ташкент» 10/mo, «услуги интернет маркетинга» 10/mo, «комплексный интернет маркетинг» 10/mo at competition 0, «маркетинг под ключ» 10/mo, «digital агентство ташкент» 10/mo at competition 0.86, and «интернет маркетинг узбекистан», «digital marketing uzbekistan» and «продвижение бизнеса ташкент» returned no volume at all. The only Russian head term in this family with real volume is «маркетинговое агентство» at 90/mo, and its live SERP carries a three-slot local pack, so it is unreachable while the business has no Google Business Profile.
architectureDecisions.note: This page is recorded as a navigational and commercial overview surface, not a money target, and it deliberately owns no cluster. It keeps its existing content, its existing internal links and its indexable status — nothing was removed, because removing links has no proven upside and would churn a page that costs nothing to keep. What changes is the rule going forward: no further optimisation budget, no new spokes, and no new page should be created for this family until either a Google Business Profile exists (which unlocks «маркетинговое агентство») or Search Console shows demand that the keyword data does not currently contain. Reconsider only on new evidence.
